channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday competitions 2026 (UK)
channel.description: 9 UK Black Friday competitions are open for 2026, and 1 more is coming; this page lists UK prize draws and competitions, not retail Black Friday sale deals; the next deadline is 18 November 2026 (TentBox Ltd) and the last is 2 December 2026 (Flower & White).

item.title: TentBox Black Friday: Win Your Cart (up to £3,000) – TentBox Ltd
item.description: Prize: The products in your entry cart, up to £3,000 incl. VAT (max. one roof tent plus accessories). Deadline: November 18, 2026. On tentbox.com add products worth £3,000 or less (max. one roof tent) to your cart, choose «Enter the draw» in the cart and submit your email. No checkout or payment needed. One entry per person. Free, UK residents 18+. 9–18 November 2026 (closes 23:59 UK time)

item.title: Healthy Metal Cabin Weekend Prize Draw: 3 nights in an off-grid cabin – Wellness Minerals Ltd (Healthy Metal)
item.description: Prize: A 3-night weekend stay for two in an off-grid cabin in the UK, worth over £500. Deadline: November 20, 2026. Submit your mobile number via the entry page on healthy-metal.com (or the Facebook/Instagram lead form or WhatsApp keyword). One free entry per person; purchases in the Black Friday early-access period also count. No purchase necessary. UK residents 18+. Closes 23:59 UK time on 20 November 2026

item.title: Castore Black Friday Competition: win 2 private box tickets for Everton v Manchester – J. Carter Sporting Club Ltd (Castore)
item.description: Prize: 2 tickets to a private box at Everton v Manchester on Tuesday 29 December at Hill Dickinson Stadium, incl. private balcony, food and drinks package and access 3 hours pre-match / 1 hour post-match (travel and hotel not included). Deadline: November 22, 2026. Fill in the entry form on Castore (full name and email address) and submit it; signing up includes consent to Castore marketing emails. One entry per person. No purchase necessary. UK residents aged 18+. 5 Nov (09:00 GMT) – 22 Nov 2026 (23:59 GMT); winner drawn within 48 hours and notified by email

item.title: KILLSTAR Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway: win a £1,000 gift card – KILLSTAR (Draco Distribution Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One £1,000 KILLSTAR gift card for one UK winner (valid 6 months). Deadline: November 22, 2026. Free: sign up for KILLSTAR emails via an official KILLSTAR sign-up form, or email giveaway@killstar.com with the subject "Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway" and your full name. Optional SMS opt-in gives one bonus entry. UK residents 18+. Closes 11:59 pm GMT on 22 November 2026

item.title: FloridaTix Black Friday Giveaway: win up to £1,500 in FloridaTix vouchers – FloridaTix
item.description: Prize: 3 FloridaTix vouchers: 1st prize £1,500, 2nd prize £1,000, 3rd prize £500 (towards a future FloridaTix booking; no cash alternative). Deadline: November 23, 2026. Free entry, no purchase necessary: complete and submit the competition pop-up on the FloridaTix Black Friday prize page with your name and email (qualifying bookings in the period are also entered automatically). Open to UK residents 18+. 5 Nov – 23 Nov 2026 11:59pm; winners drawn at random and announced 24 Nov 2026

item.title: TrueNorth Tech X Black Friday Giveaway: win a DualSense controller + Razer headset – TrueNorth Tech X (Featherstone, West Yorkshire)
item.description: Prize: A PlayStation DualSense Wireless Controller (White) and a Razer BlackShark V2 X wired gaming headset (worth over £95), 1 winner. Deadline: November 26, 2026. Fill in the free entry form on truenorthtechx.com/giveaway/ and confirm via the email link, or email the promoter with the subject "Black Friday giveaway entry" plus your full name, email and UK county. No purchase; newsletter opt-in is optional. UK residents 18+, one entry per person. 9 Nov – 26 Nov 2026 23:59 UK time; winner drawn on Black Friday, 27 Nov

item.title: BOOHOOMAN Black Friday £1K Cash Comp: win £1,000 cash – BOOHOOMAN (Boohoo.com UK Limited)
item.description: Prize: £1,000 cash (1 winner across all participating countries). Deadline: November 27, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the BOOHOOMAN Black Friday Countdown page with first name, last name, email and date of birth (mobile optional); you agree to BOOHOOMAN marketing emails. Free, no purchase. Open to 18+ residents of the UK, Ireland, the US, France, Germany, the Netherlands and Australia. 9 Nov (09:30 GMT) – 27 Nov 2026 23:59 GMT; one winner announced by email on 30 Nov 2026

item.title: Ordo Black Friday Airbnb Giveaway 2026 (UK) – Ordo (Ordoclub Ltd)
item.description: Prize: Six Airbnb gift cards: £1,500, 2 × £500 and 3 × £250 (total £3,250). Deadline: November 29, 2026. Enter via the online form with name and email or mobile; no purchase and no marketing opt-in required. UK residents 18+. 1 Nov 16:00 GMT to 29 Nov 2026 23:59 GMT

item.title: Flower & White Black Friday VIP giveaway: £500 in vouchers – Flower & White
item.description: Prize: £250 Secret Escapes voucher + £250 Love2shop voucher (£500 total), one winner. Deadline: December 2, 2026. Join the Black Friday VIP list via the sign-up form on the page. Free, one entry per person, UK residents 18+. Winner drawn 2 December 2026; page says entries until 6 December 2026

item.title: Cartridge People Black Colourful Friday free daily prize draw – The Cartridge People Ltd
item.description: Prize: Seven daily prizes 23–29 Nov, incl. a Samsung Q7F 55" 4K TV, Shark Freestyle Max vacuum, Ninja coffee machine, Lenovo tablet, Cricut Explore 4 and Samsung Odyssey monitor + Brother scanner. Deadline: November 29, 2026. Free entry form on the Cartridge People Black Friday promotion page, once per day from 23 to 29 November 2026 (each day closes 23:59 GMT). No purchase necessary; orders also give an automatic entry. UK & Channel Islands residents 18+
